item.title: Punjab extends smog curbs, Lahore schools go online on Mondays
item.description: Schools in Lahore will teach online on Mondays and markets have been told to close early under the extended smog plan.

item.title: Dengue cases decline in Rawalpindi as temperatures drop
item.description: Health officials in Rawalpindi reported fewer new dengue cases this week as night temperatures fell.

item.title: Peshawar BRT adds a new route to Hayatabad
